html:
Radio Luxembourg was a commercial radio station broadcasting from Luxembourg from 1933. Its English service reached millions of listeners in Britain.

In Britain the BBC held a monopoly and played little popular music. A powerful transmitter in the Grand Duchy filled that gap with advertising and records. From the 1950s its evening shows were where young Britons heard rock and roll and the early Beatles. Pirate radio and then BBC Radio 1 in 1967 took much of its audience, and the English service closed in 1992.

The company behind it grew into RTL Group, one of Europe's largest broadcasters. It is a sign of how Luxembourg made a living from services sold across borders.
sum: Radio Luxembourg was a commercial radio station broadcasting from Luxembourg from 1933. Its English service reached millions of listeners in Britain.
